text: vp_generate() computes requires, excludes -least-one graphs feature model (UVL) Boolean formula (DIMACS) model written notation. vp_classify() classifies features, vp_history() runs every version model. vp_* functions analyse graphs: reading, measures feature, hierarchy, whole model, conflicts, configuration teams, testing, patterns evolution. vp_plot() draws R package DiagrammeR, Graphviz need installed; engine = "graphviz" uses installed Graphviz instead.
